build_FlowNetC_model: build a FlowNetC optical flow network model with batch normalization and fp16 correlation support
run_FlowNetC_forward: run the FlowNetC forward pass on a concatenated image pair tensor to predict optical flow
create_FlowNetC_correlation: create a correlation layer with configurable pad size and max displacement for feature matching
test_FlowNetC_multiscale_flow: test the FlowNetC model to verify it returns multiscale flow predictions during training mode
review_FlowNetC_decoder: review the FlowNetC decoder upsampling and deconvolution layers for optical flow refinement
